## Decision record

<!-- d10e: auto-prune -->
<!-- Copier-vendored from the agentic-engineering-template — do NOT edit
     here; change it in the template and pull via `copier update`. The
     auto-prune marker above lets `disambiguate prune` remove this term
     from a repo that never links it. -->

An immutable JSON file capturing one durable ruling — question, options as
they stood before the ruling, prediction, choice, reasons, rejections, and
outcome — on the shared [record contract](record-contract.md). Records are
append-only: corrections happen by superseding, never by editing.
